scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.test:unit: vitest run tests/engine.test.ts tests/boundaries.test.ts tests/ui-model.test.ts tests/feature-audit.test.ts tests/map-area.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: vitest run tests/integration.test.ts tests/worker.test.ts tests/backend.test.ts tests/backend-database.test.ts tests/backend-map.test.ts
scripts.test:security: vitest run tests/security.test.ts tests/backend-security.test.ts tests/backend-secrets.test.ts tests/backend-map.test.ts
scripts.test:browser-worker: npm run build:worker && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.tools/ms-playwright playwright test --config playwright.worker.config.ts
scripts.test:penetration: vitest run tests/backend-security.test.ts tests/backend-map.test.ts && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.tools/ms-playwright playwright test tests/e2e/security.spec.ts tests/e2e/backend.spec.ts tests/e2e/map.spec.ts
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:server && vitest run tests/backend*.test.ts
scripts.test:load: npm run build:server && node --import tsx scripts/load-test.ts
